scope_decision: English-only meaningful conversation is acceptable; Korean capability is out of scope for this screen and is not claimed.
hypothesis: The corrected shared path can learn prompt-conditioned English replies when every selected dialogue window retains its complete canonical prompt-response document. This screen tests that path without changing the prior architecture, seed, endpoint, optimizer, source revision, greedy decode, or per-language bar.

execution.models_and_training_data: private Hugging Face dancinlab repositories only

data.reason: The existing immutable revision already contains provenance-preserved English general text and human-reviewed Apache-2.0 OpenAssistant dialogue, explicit validation splits, exact deduplication, and zero exact panel contamination. Re-uploading identical data would not add evidence.
data.source: OpenAssistant/oasst1@fdf72ae0827c1cda404aff25b6603abec9e3399b, English reviewed non-synthetic best paths, Apache-2.0

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 14000; intermediate outputs are recovery evidence only

framed_sampling.dialogue_requirement: sample only complete canonical chat documents fitting the causal window

conversation_gate.manual_meaning_review: all 7 responses must be relevant, intelligible, and answer the registered question
conversation_gate.scorer_controls: all registered positive and negative controls must pass before checkpoint loading

failure_policy.if_training_or_conversation_fails: record and upload raw failure artifacts; do not run another seed, extend steps, tune decode, or start R1
failure_policy.if_automatic_passes_but_manual_fails: record FAIL-MANUAL-MEANING and keep R1 and production locked

promotion.r1: LOCKED; a passing screen requires a separate multi-seed R0 protocol before R1
